qe: Read the passage and answer: 'Punctuality and courteous communication form the backbone of public service delivery. When front-desk officials explain required documents clearly in simple language, citizens save repeated trips and build lasting trust in local administration.' — Question: What two qualities are described as the backbone of public service delivery?
qh: गद्यांश के अनुसार जन सेवा वितरण की रीढ़ किन दो गुणों को बताया गया है?
oh: समयबद्धता और विनम्र संवाद (Punctuality and courteous communication)
e: Sentence 1 directly identifies 'Punctuality and courteous communication'.

qe: Read the passage and answer: 'Punctuality and courteous communication form the backbone of public service delivery. When front-desk officials explain required documents clearly in simple language, citizens save repeated trips and build lasting trust in local administration.' — Question: What happens when front-desk staff explain document requirements clearly?
qh: जब फ्रंट-डेस्क कर्मचारी दस्तावेज़ आवश्यकताओं को स्पष्ट रूप से समझाते हैं तो क्या होता है?
oe: Citizens save repeated trips and develop trust in administration
oh: नागरिकों के बार-बार के चक्कर बचते हैं और प्रशासन पर विश्वास बढ़ता है
नागरिक आना बंद कर देते हैं
e: Clear communication saves citizens repeated visits and builds institutional trust.

qe: Read the passage and answer: 'Punctuality and courteous communication form the backbone of public service delivery. When front-desk officials explain required documents clearly in simple language, citizens save repeated trips and build lasting trust in local administration.' — Question: Which word in the passage is opposite in meaning to 'rude or impolite'?
qh: गद्यांश में 'अशिष्ट या असभ्य' (rude/impolite) के विपरीत अर्थ वाला शब्द कौन-सा है?
e: 'Courteous' means polite and respectful.

qe: Cloze: 'Before signing an official circular, proofread it (A) _____ to ensure there are no (B) _____ errors.' Choose the best pair:
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Before signing an official circular, proofread it (A) _____ to ensure there are no (B) _____ errors.'
e: Careful proofreading prevents factual/typographical errors.

qe: Choose the correct Question Tag: 'Nobody called the office today, ______?'
qh: सही Question Tag चुनें: 'Nobody called the office today, ______?'
e: 'Nobody' is negative and uses pronoun 'they' in tags → positive tag 'did they?'.

qe: Change to Passive Voice: 'Who broke the glass window?'
qh: Passive Voice में बदलें: 'Who broke the glass window?'
oe: By whom is the glass window broken?
By whom was the glass window broken?
Who was broken the glass window?
oh: By whom is the glass window broken?
By whom was the glass window broken?
Who was broken the glass window?
e: 'Who + V₂' → 'By whom + was + object + V₃?'.

qe: Convert to Indirect Speech: He said, "Hurrah! We have won the match."
qh: Indirect Speech में बदलें: He said, "Hurrah! We have won the match."
oe: He exclaimed with joy that they had won the match.
He said hurrah we won match.
He asked if they won match.
He exclaimed with sorrow that they won.
oh: He exclaimed with joy that they had won the match.
He said hurrah we won match.
He asked if they won match.
He exclaimed with sorrow that they won.
e: 'Hurrah!' converts to 'exclaimed with joy that...', and 'have won' → 'had won'.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'The clerk was accused ______ forging the signature.'
qh: सही Preposition भरें: 'The clerk was accused ______ forging the signature.'
e: 'Accused' always takes 'of' ('accused of a crime/act').

qe: Fill in the blank: 'Mathematics ______ my favourite subject in school.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Mathematics ______ my favourite subject in school.'
e: Subject names ending in '-ics' (Mathematics, Physics, Economics) take singular verbs ('is').

qe: Choose the SYNONYM of 'FORTITUDE':
qh: 'FORTITUDE' (धैर्य एवं साहस) का समानार्थी चुनें:
e: Fortitude = mental courage in pain or adversity.

qe: Choose the ANTONYM of 'MITIGATE' (to lessen severity):
qh: 'MITIGATE' (कम करना/घटाना) का विलोम चुनें:
e: Mitigate = make less severe; Aggravate = make worse.

qe: One-word substitution for: 'Something that is no longer in use'
qh: वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: 'Something that is no longer in use'
e: Obsolete = outdated and no longer used.

qe: Choose the word with the CORRECT spelling for 'a person working together in the same organization':
qh: 'सहकर्मी' अर्थ वाले अंग्रेजी शब्द की सही वर्तनी चुनें:
e: Correct spelling: C-O-L-L-E-A-G-U-E.

qe: What does the idiom 'To add fuel to the fire' mean?
qh: 'To add fuel to the fire' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ क्या है?
oe: To make an already bad situation or conflict worse
To calm down an angry person
oh: पहले से खराब स्थिति या झगड़े को और भड़काना/बिगाड़ना
e: Adding fuel to fire worsens an existing conflict.

qe: What does the idiom 'Once and for all' mean?
qh: 'Once and for all' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
oe: Finally and decisively, so the matter is permanently settled
oh: अंतिम और निर्णायक रूप से (हमेशा के लिए निपटारा)
e: 'Once and for all' means completely and permanently.

qe: Arrange to form a meaningful sentence: 1. regularly  2. practice  3. speed  4. typing  5. to improve
qh: सार्थक वाक्य बनाने हेतु सही क्रम चुनें: 1. regularly  2. practice  3. speed  4. typing  5. to improve
e: 2-1-5-4-3 forms: 'Practice regularly to improve typing speed.'

qe: Spot the error: 'She has returned back (A) / from Patna (B) / this morning. (C) / No error (D)'
qh: त्रुटि वाला भाग पहचानें: 'She has returned back (A) / from Patna (B) / this morning. (C) / No error (D)'
e: 'Return back', 'repeat again', and 'revert back' are tautological errors.

qe: Improve the quoted part: 'I prefer walking "than" cycling.'
qh: उद्धृत भाग सुधारें: 'I prefer walking "than" cycling.'
e: 'Prefer + gerund + to + gerund': 'I prefer walking to cycling.'

qe: Choose the correct modal for past habit: 'In his youth, he ______ walk 5 km every morning.'
qh: भूतकाल की आदत दर्शाने हेतु सही विकल्प चुनें: 'In his youth, he ______ walk 5 km every morning.'
e: 'Used to' expresses a discontinued past habit.

qe: Choose the SYNONYM of 'LENIENT' (not strict):
qh: 'LENIENT' (उदार/नरम) का समानार्थी चुनें:
e: Lenient = permissive, mild, merciful.

qe: Choose the ANTONYM of 'IGNORANCE':
qh: 'IGNORANCE' (अज्ञानता) का विलोम चुनें:
e: Ignorance = lack of knowledge; Knowledge/Wisdom = awareness and understanding.

qe: Select the sentence in Present Continuous tense:
qh: Present Continuous Tense वाला वाक्य चुनें:
oe: The printer is printing the admit cards.
The printer has printed the cards.
oh: The printer is printing the admit cards.
The printer has printed the cards.
e: is/am/are + V₁-ing ('is printing') is Present Continuous.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'Hardly had I stepped out ______ it started raining.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Hardly had I stepped out ______ it started raining.'
e: 'Hardly ... when' is the standard correlative conjunction.

qe: Choose the correct collocation with 'effort':
qh: 'effort' के साथ सही अंग्रेजी कोलोकेशन चुनें:
e: Standard collocation: 'make an effort'.

qe: One-word substitution for: 'A person who is present everywhere at the same time'
qh: वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: 'A person/entity present everywhere at the same time'
e: Omnipresent = everywhere; Omnipotent = all-powerful; Omniscient = all-knowing.

qe: Choose the word with the CORRECT spelling for 'a formal written order/permission from a higher official':
qh: 'अनुशंसा / सिफारिश' अर्थ वाले अंग्रेजी शब्द की सही वर्तनी चुनें:
e: One 'c', double 'm': R-E-C-O-M-M-E-N-D-A-T-I-O-N.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'He divided the sweets ______ his two sons.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'He divided the sweets ______ his two sons.'
e: 'Between' is used for two persons/items.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'The committee ______ unanimous in its decision.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'The committee ______ unanimous in its decision.'
e: Acting as a single unanimous unit ('its decision'), 'committee' takes singular verb 'was'.

qe: What does the idiom 'To keep one's fingers crossed' mean?
qh: 'To keep one's fingers crossed' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
oe: To hope for good luck or a positive result
To type fast on a keyboard
oh: अच्छे भाग्य या सकारात्मक परिणाम की आशा करना
e: 'Keep fingers crossed' expresses hopeful anticipation of success.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'She has been waiting for the bus ______ two hours.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'She has been waiting for the bus ______ two hours.'
e: Duration of time ('two hours') takes 'for'.
